defStrong: to waken (transitively or intransitively), i.e. rouse (literally, from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively, from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, nonexistence)
defKjv: awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-)rise (again, up), stand, take up
derivacion: probably akin to the base of G58 (ἀγορά) (through the idea of collecting one's faculties);
